# Pinned to the versions the app is run and tested with (Python 3.12), so an
# install made today and one made next month get the same libraries, and an
# update changes them only when this file does. Raise a pin deliberately and
# test before committing it.

fastapi==0.141.1
uvicorn==0.52.3

pydantic==2.13.4
requests==2.34.2
huggingface_hub==1.27.0
pywebview==6.2.1
psutil==7.2.2

# The voice engine. Pinned with its own dependencies: a different onnxruntime or
# phonemizer can change how a sentence sounds, and sleep recordings cache audio
# per sentence.
kokoro-onnx==0.5.0
onnxruntime==1.28.0
espeakng-loader==0.2.4
phonemizer-fork==3.3.2
numpy==2.5.2
scipy==1.18.0
soundfile==0.14.0
pydub==0.25.1

# Document formats
ebooklib==0.20
xhtml2pdf==0.2.17
beautifulsoup4==4.15.0
lxml==6.1.1
Markdown==3.10.3

# pydub imports the stdlib audioop module, which PEP 594 removed in Python 3.13.
# audioop-lts is the drop-in replacement, and it requires 3.13+, so it must stay
# behind a marker or it breaks installs on 3.12.
audioop-lts; python_version >= "3.13"
